say.variants.experienced: Garden plots are finally paying off, {addressee.name}. First decent harvest we've pulled in weeks.
Root cellar's looking fuller than it has in a month, {addressee.name}. Plenty of fresh cabbage and potatoes.
Supply crates are stocked up nicely, {addressee.name}. Takes some weight off everybody's shoulders.
say.variants.rumor: Word is the farms outside town brought in a strong harvest, {addressee.name}. Might ease things up for everybody.
Heard from traders that produce and dry goods are moving again down the county road, {addressee.name}.
Folks are saying the valley fields came through big this week, {addressee.name}. Finally some good news.
say.variants.uncertain: Can't say how long it'll last, {addressee.name}, but folks say there's extra harvest moving through the camps.
Might just be hopeful talk, {addressee.name}, though traders looked a lot less desperate today.
Heard a rumor about fresh crops coming in from the river farms, {addressee.name}. Hope it's true.
say.variants.reply: Good to hear, {addressee.name}. Let's get what we can jarred and stored before it spoils.
About time we caught a break, {addressee.name}. Helps keep folks steady when bellies aren't empty.
Music to my ears, {addressee.name}. Let's put some aside for the lean weeks ahead.
